name: MonarchPresenceDot
title: PresenceDot
wrapsNative: Circle and RoundedRectangle shapes with accessibilityLabel
summary: A small dot for a person's presence: online, away, busy, do not disturb or offline.
whenToUse: Beside a name or on an avatar, to show whether a person can be reached.
whenNotToUse: For the status of a thing rather than a person, use a badge or MonarchStatusDot.
api: init(_ status: MonarchPresenceStatus, customStatus: String? = nil, size: MonarchPresenceDotSize = .md, isDecorative: Bool = false, statusLabel: String? = nil, isOverlay: Bool = false)
static func label(for status: MonarchPresenceStatus, customStatus: String? = nil) -> String
enum MonarchPresenceStatus { case online, away, busy, doNotDisturb, offline }
enum MonarchPresenceDotSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: customStatus
options.description: The person's own status message, added to the spoken text.

options.name: isDecorative
options.description: Hides the dot from VoiceOver when nearby text says the same.

options.name: statusLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the presence.

options.name: isOverlay
options.description: Draws a 2-point ring in the surface colour around the dot, for a dot on an avatar.

states.name: online
states.description: A dot in the success colour.

states.name: away
states.description: A dot in the warning colour; half-filled with Differentiate Without Colour.

states.name: busy
states.description: A dot in the danger colour; a square with Differentiate Without Colour.

states.name: do not disturb
states.description: A dot in the danger colour with a bar across it.

states.name: offline
states.description: A ring in the subtle text colour on the surface colour.

appearance: Solid status colours of the theme, so the dot follows light, dark and high contrast. The overlay ring is the surface colour.
platformNotes: The web gives each status its own shape only in forced-colours mode; iOS does the same when Differentiate Without Colour is on. The web positions an overlay dot itself; on iOS place it with overlay(alignment: .bottomTrailing). The web's hover title has no counterpart on touch. The custom status is one string here, where the web takes an emoji and a text.
accessibility: The dot is one element read as its text, such as "Away · In a meeting".
Do not disturb has a bar and offline is a ring in every setting; with Differentiate Without Colour, away is half-filled and busy is a square, so all five differ by form.
isDecorative hides the dot when the presence is already in text beside it.
The dot scales with Dynamic Type.
The dot is not interactive and has no touch target.
edgeCases: A custom status of only white space is ignored.
Without Differentiate Without Colour, online, away and busy differ by colour only for sighted users; show the presence in text where it matters.
The half-filled away dot fills its leading half, so it mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
